notes.title: Sale Information
notes.notes:
To commemorate the upcoming release of "Dies irae ~Interview with Kaziklu 
Bey~" on Steam on February 28th, Acts I and II of "Dies irae ~Amantes 
amentes~" will be on sale for 40% off from February 14th until "Dies irae 
~Interview with Kaziklu Bey~"'s release on February 28th!
